simple.meaning: to call out to (i.e. properly, address by name, but used in a wide variety of applications)
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to קָרָא (H7121) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 739 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: קָרָא (qârâʼ) means to call out to (i.e. properly, address by name, but used in a wide variety of applications) First listed occurrence: 1Chr 4 9.

definitions.short: to call out to (i.e. properly, address by name, but used in a wide variety of applications)

Niph`al Perfect 3masculine singular נִקְרָא Jer 4:20 +, 1 singular נִקְרֵאתִי Est 4:11 , etc.; Imperfect 3masculine singular יִקָּרֵא Gen 2:23 +, וַיִּקָּרֵא Ezek 20:29 +, etc.; Participle נִקְרָא Isa 43:7 ; Jer 44:26 ; plural נִקְרָאִים Isa 48:1 ; Est 6:1 ; — 1 reflexive , נִק הַקֹּדֶשׁ ׳מֵעִיר Isa 48:2 from the holy city they call themselves. 2 passive be called: a. be proclaimed (compare Qal 3 ), of י ׳שֵׁם Jer 44:26 ( בְּפֶה instrumental); of man's name = be famous Ruth 4:14 ; = be announced Jer 4:20 . b. be read aloud compare Qal 4 ): impersonal with ב of book, + בְּאָוְנֵי Neh 13:1 ; subject records Est 6:1 ( לפְנֵי ). c. be summoned (compare Qal 5 : Isa 31:4 ( עַל against ); Est 3:12 ; 4:11 (twice in verse); verse); 8: 9; + בְּשֵׁם , i.e. specifically, 2:14 , d. be named (compare Qal 6. ): (I) appell. subject + ל person Gen 2:23 to her shall be called 'woman' , 1Sam 9:9 ; Isa 32:5 ; 62:4 , 12 ; Prov 16:21 ; + ל location 2Sam 18:18 ; Isa 1:26 ; 35:8 ; Jer 19:6 . (2) ונו שְׁמוֺ ׳וְנִקְרָא Deut 25:10 , so Gen 35:10 ; Dan 10:1 ; Ezek 20:29 (of place); אֶתשִֿׁמְךָ 20:29 . (3) יְרוּשׁ ׳וְנִקְרְאָה ׳וגו Zech 8:3 , so land Deut 3:18 , temple Isa 56:7 . (4) especially י שֵׁם ׳נִקְרָא עַל , denoting ownership, of person Jer 15:16 , people Deut 28:10 ; Jer 14:9 ; Amos 9:12 ; Isa 63:19 ; 2Chr 7:14 , ark 2Sam 6:2 (strike out 2nd ᵐ5 שֵׁם We Dr and others), = 1Chr 13:6 (adding עָלָיו Oettli Kau; > Kit Hpt שָׁם שְׁמוֺ ), temple 1Kin 8:43 2Chr 6:33 ; Jer 7:10-11 , 14 , 30 ; 32:34 ; 34:15 , city 25:29 ; Dan 9:18 , city + people 9:19 ; so name of man 2Sam 12:28 , as given to his wife Isa 4:1 (5) be called שֵׁם עַל , i.e. reckoned to, Gen 48:6 ; Isa 54:5 ; 61:6 ; עַלאשֵׁבֶט 1Chr 23:14 , compare Ezra 2:61 = Neh 7:63 . (6) be called בְּשֵׁם Isa 43:7 ; 48:1 . (7) יִקּ ׳בְּיִצְתָק זָ֑רַע ךְָָ Gen 21:12 , i.e. in (through) ׳יִצ shall seed be reckoned to three; שְׁמִי בָהֶם וְיִקָּרֵא 48:16 through them shall my name be called , i.e. perpetuated. (8) be named = menationed, of person Isa 14:20 (9) subject שֵׁם Eccl 6:10 , i.e. thing is known.
